name: Puchikko ☆ My Lord
source:
Yuji Numakura is a lolicon protagonist who has always wanted to get closer to loli girls. One night Yuji met a girl in the park at night. The girl said, "I don't know how to get home," as her twin tails swayed and she looked down sadly. The girl with an anxious face was Mom Tachibana, apparently her family had come to take a preview of some property and she had gotten lost while strolling around the city. Yuji resists the urge to take her home and did the gentlemanly thing of taking her to the police. 

A few days later when he opened the door to go to work he saw an angel. Surprisingly, Momo moved into the room next to Yuji's! She began coming to his room often. As he spends his happy days being loved by Momo will he find that he truly is a lolicon pervert!? 

[Translated from the Official Website]
